up: Show the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649971, including the ChEMBL ID, molecule name, canonical SMILES, and the activity standard relation, standard value, and standard units.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS molecule_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649971'
  AND a.standard_relation IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
